newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks drop at noon in lacklustre trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks drop at noon in lacklustre trade.

text.p: Pakistan stocks dropped at noon on Wednesday amid dull trading as sentiment weakened after the Corporate Law Authority (CLA) removed a member from two exchanges, dealers said.
"This news has dampened the sentiment," dealer Usma Shoaib said. "Investors are cautious and appear in a wait-and-see mood."
The index fell 2.70 points, or 0.17 percent, to 1,578.82 at noon. Losers led gainers 136 to 59. Shell Pakistan fell 1.0 rupees to 242. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
